description: Public factual metadata sources used by the bundled song dictionary. Audio, lyrics, images and long descriptive prose are not included.

sources.name: アイマスDB (unofficial fan database)
sources.note: Source URL attribution is retained per event/credit. Live index begins in 2013; the separate song/CD database is an older, incomplete catalog through 2017. Official date corrections have independent evidence. This source does not guarantee completeness or recording identity.

sources.name: MusicBrainz core metadata
sources.service_note: The public API is free for non-commercial use. Requests identify the app and are limited to at most one per second. Commercial API usage requires a separate review of MusicBrainz service terms.

sources.name: Existing verified Korean display-name catalogs
sources.note: Original display-name catalogs retain their own source lists. Korean aliases improve local search; they never change the original recording identity.

sources.name: Official label product track lists and release dates
included: exact reviewed release and recording identities
format-specific release dates with independent source URLs
sources.note: Physical product dates use the official label page. Digital dates retain their separate MusicBrainz source. These reviewed facts never merge different recording IDs.

limitations: This catalog does not claim complete coverage of the franchise or all recording versions.

Unbranded albums require an Official release and explicit franchise artist evidence or an independently reviewed exact recording/release ID and title match; voice-actor solo careers and title-only similarities are not sufficient.
A MusicBrainz release marked Official is a community-maintained metadata fact, not a rights or Spotify availability guarantee.
Unverified work-to-recording relationships are not inferred from matching titles.
Series use explicit release branding, a Gakuen credit, or exact reviewed recording/release evidence; ambiguous records remain other.
Instrumental and spoken classifications use explicit dialogue credits, conservative title hints and exact independently reviewed track lists, not audio analysis.
Music genre and current account-specific Spotify availability remain separate from this snapshot.
